title: RoutineState

id.description: A routine's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, so a create can queue offline.

savedUnderCeiling.description: The ceiling of the client session whose create, edit, import or enable last touched it: every firing's mode is clamped to it.

savedBy.description: The client session whose create, edit, import or enable last touched it.

createdAt.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

editedAt.description: When its definition was last edited or replaced by an import; null until then.

environmentId.description: An environment's persistent id: a UUID made on its first start, kept across address changes.

routineId.description: A routine's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, so a create can queue offline.

at.description: When the move was recorded here.

anyOf.description: The other copy of a moved routine: its environment, its id there, and when the move was recorded here.

movedFrom.description: The routine this one is a moved copy of; null for one made here.

environmentId.description: An environment's persistent id: a UUID made on its first start, kept across address changes.

routineId.description: A routine's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, so a create can queue offline.

at.description: When the move was recorded here.

anyOf.description: The other copy of a moved routine: its environment, its id there, and when the move was recorded here.

movedTo.description: The copy this one was moved to, which disabled it; null until moved, and cleared when it is enabled.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of the output's exact bytes.

baseline.description: The pre-check output of the latest firing that ended succeeded or silent, by its hash and when it ran; null until one has.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

handledThrough.description: The latest due time handled, as a firing or a skip; moved to the save time when the routine is created, enabled, or its schedule or zone edited, so no earlier due time is owed. Null for a routine with no due time handled or owed.

firingId.description: A history entry's id, a firing's or a skip's: a UUID the environment mints; a firing's is its session's command id, so a retry after a crash makes nothing twice.

trigger.description: What made an entry: schedule (a due time on time), catch-up (the latest of due times missed while the environment was down, fired once) or run-now (routines.runNow).

dueAt.description: The due time it fires for; for run now, when it was asked.

startedAt.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

runId.description: The firing's live run: its first, or the one that continues it after an update.

anyOf.description: A firing that has started and not ended: its id, trigger, due time, start, session and live run.

liveFiring.description: The firing that has started and not ended; null when none is live.

entryId.description: A history entry's id, a firing's or a skip's: a UUID the environment mints; a firing's is its session's command id, so a retry after a crash makes nothing twice.

outcome.description: How a firing ended: succeeded (its run completed with text other than the silence marker, or none), silent (its final text was the silence marker, so nothing was delivered), failed (with its reason) or cancelled (a person interrupted it, or deleted its session or its routine).

anyOf.description: Why a firing failed: run_error (its run ended in error), timed_out (its maximum duration passed and its run was interrupted), restart (its run was cut by a restart, or let go with its session still there) or drained (a drain cut its run and nothing continued it).

reason.description: Why it failed; null unless it did.

oneOf.description: The latest entry was a firing that ended: its outcome, and why when it failed.

entryId.description: A history entry's id, a firing's or a skip's: a UUID the environment mints; a firing's is its session's command id, so a retry after a crash makes nothing twice.

reason.description: Why a due time was skipped: no-change (the pre-check's output was the baseline's), pre-check-failed (the pre-check failed; a failure), cannot-start (the firing could not start, with a reason of its own; a failure), missed (missed while the environment was down, and not caught up) or overlap (a firing of the routine was live).

oneOf.description: The latest entry was a skip: why.

anyOf.description: How the routine's latest ended entry ended: a firing's outcome, or a skip's reason.

lastOutcome.description: How its latest ended entry ended; null before its first.

failureStreak.description: Consecutive failed firings and failing skips (pre-check-failed, cannot-start), reset by succeeded, silent or no-change.

description: A routine's state, the environment's and never exported: its id, what it was saved under and by whom, when, its move links, baseline, handledThrough, live firing, last outcome and failure streak.
